verdict.rationale: Salesmate documents its own publicly available RESTful APIs and 'API and integration support for extended workflows', so a first-party API exists. Nothing in the evidence shows the API covers everything the UI can do. Probes for an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt on apidocs all returned 404, so the API's breadth cannot be verified. Missing for 10: documented API coverage across contacts, deals, pipelines, campaigns, calls and AI agents; a published API reference or OpenAPI spec; an explicit API–UI parity statement; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
